scripts.lint: biome check && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check
scripts.format: biome check --write && uv run ruff format && uv run ruff check --fix
scripts.typecheck: uv run ty check && tsc -p frontend
scripts.test: vitest run --root frontend && uv run pytest
scripts.coverage: vitest run --root frontend --coverage && uv run coverage run && uv run coverage report
scripts.deploy: uv run pywrangler deploy --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
scripts.check: pnpm format && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test -q --tb=short && pnpm build && pnpm check_worker
